description: Webhook of the Lark content bot at /webhook/content-agent (event and card callback URL). Answers Lark's URL check and acknowledges at once. Button clicks: accepted from the owner or from anyone in the team group, with the row's current token; records the decision as an event and tells the agent. Messages from direct chats and groups go to 'Content agent: lark message'.
name: Content agent: lark

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $('Decide').first().json;
return d.agent ? [{ json: { mode: 'event', text: d.agent } }] : [];
